question: Who Owns Panda Express?
quick_answer: Panda Express is privately owned by its founders, Andrew and Peggy Cherng, through their company Panda Restaurant Group. They opened the first Panda Express in 1983 in Glendale, California, and have kept the company family-owned and private, so it does not trade on a stock exchange.
key_facts: Owner: founders Andrew and Peggy Cherng, via Panda Restaurant Group
The largest American Chinese fast-food chain

body.heading: Who owns Panda Express?
body.text: Panda Express is owned by its founders, Andrew and Peggy Cherng, through Panda Restaurant Group. The couple has kept the company private and family-controlled rather than selling to investors or going public, so there is no Panda Express stock to buy.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: The Cherngs opened the first Panda Express in 1983 in a Glendale, California mall, building on an earlier full-service restaurant called Panda Inn. Panda Express grew into the largest American Chinese fast-food chain, known for dishes like Orange Chicken.

body.heading: Still family-owned
body.text: Decades later, Panda Express remains privately held by the founding family. Staying private has let the Cherngs keep control of the brand and its direction while expanding across the US and beyond.
